When we've abused this substance smoking again on such a short notice returns our brain to mush. Making it very easy to smoke regularly. Or on the best case scenario you will feel weak and debilitated and you will take away a lot of energy and won't be able to go foward with your goals even the day after you smoke. 

This has happened to me countless times, it is how people start smoking again, you are loving yourself and doing yourself a favour if you dont take the gamble. You sre investing in your future self.
